testing_gaps: CurrentProgressRegressionTest mocks mapper outcomes without exercising SQL predicates or row locks. Add a database-backed scenario covering changing today's time points after an earlier dose, and pause/resume before and after the scheduled time; verify no past dose is regenerated and future cancelled tasks are restored once.

Concurrent acceptance of the same family invitation is protected by a conditional database update, but CurrentProgressRegressionTest has no database-backed two-client acceptance test verifying exactly one ACTIVE binding and clearing invite_code/invite_expire_at.

The existing medicine-ownership regression mocks a missing medicine without inspecting the SQL ownership predicate; a database-backed request with another user's real medicine would verify the complete IDOR rejection path.

Expired-session clearing and single login redirection in HttpUtil have no runtime evidence for simultaneous 401 responses; verify token, nickname, and user ID are removed and protected pages disappear from the back stack.

Plan pause, resume, update, and delete now cancel or restore existing reminders, but no test exercises the lifecycle or verifies that only future tasks under enabled time points are restored. A database-backed lifecycle test would catch stale or missing reminders after plan changes.

scanExpiredTasks now changes a prior DELAYED record to UNCONFIRMED and emits an event and notification after a conditional claim; no test covers either the delayed-record expiry or a failed claim, so duplicate or missing alerts remain unverified.

The statistics test contains only a TAKEN record. It does not verify that a DELAYED-only response remains unconfirmed and contributes zero to completion rate, which is a changed user-visible statistic.

findings.title: Delay test never checks persisted reminder time
findings.suggested_fix: Add a focused delay test that inspects the update wrapper's persisted lastTriggerAt and expireAt values, preferably with a fixed clock or a bounded before/after interval; also assert the reminder remains confirmable after the original expiry.

findings.title: Ownership test does not verify user filter
findings.suggested_fix: Capture the MedicineMapper query wrapper and assert it filters by medicine ID and user ID, or replace the mock with a small integration fixture containing an owned and a foreign medicine.

testing_gaps: CurrentProgressRegressionTest uses mocked mapper updates, so SQL locking/conditional claim interleavings are not exercised against a database. Target concurrent generation versus pause and invitation double claim with real transaction boundaries.

findings.title: Stale unauthorized responses erase a new login
findings.suggested_fix: Capture the token or session generation at request dispatch and process a 401 only if it still matches the active session; increment the generation on successful saveToken. Keep redirect de-duplication within that session generation.
